output.reason: The linked PR [ev-00d37cdba023] says what the one-line changelog entry [ev-06e1c2a72db2] leaves out. The in-flight query log lines (for both started and retrying queries) gain new fields: query hash, start and end time, start and end delta, and query length. [ev-e900a3f6b765] and [ev-e8622098d14b] place this in the query-range path (queryrangebase/retry.go and roundtrip.go). No flag, config key or opt-in is mentioned, so the evidence supports this applicability: any deployment that serves queries through the query-range middleware, with nothing else required. The consequence is only additive: the log lines carry more fields and nothing is said to break or need operator action. Confidence is low because the evidence never says outright that the change applies to everyone; I inferred that from the absence of any gate.
